architecture_fit: Fit summary: Strong fit for Redwood Private. Recommend AWS VPC topology: separate prod VPC per region (us-east-1, eu-west-1) with Transit Gateway to corporate TGW for cross-account connectivity. In each prod VPC: public subnet (bastion/jumpbox + NAT), private app subnets for inference GPU pools, private mgmt subnet for control-plane agents if customer wants customer-managed control plane. VPC endpoints: S3, KMS, STS, ECR (if pulling images), Secrets Manager. Egress: allow only to S3 vendor buckets and Redwood update endpoints via NAT + egress proxy; block all other internet egress. Inbound: only from corporate CIDR over DirectConnect/VPN; terminate SSO/OIDC via customer Okta. KMS/HSM: support customer-managed CMKs with CloudHSM-backed keys and envelope encryption; provide key policy templates. Audit logging: send application logs + VPC flow logs to Splunk forwarded through VPC endpoint; enable immutable storage with 7-year retention. Regions: recommend pilot in eu-west-1 (complies with EU residency) and us-east-1 for NA customers. Latency: place GPU clusters in same AZs as LB and model cache to meet p95 <50ms for chat. Operational notes: provide terraform module + checklist for customer infra team; run 90-min security & network workshop to finalize CIDRs, TGW attachments, and HSM procurement plan.
